entries.test: Contemporaneous search-quality evidence, user responses, and Bing coverage could establish whether Google's search degradation harmed its competitive position and helped Bing attract favorable headlines.
entries.note: The passage attributes competitive harm to Google's search changes. 'Everybody' is colloquial emphasis here.

entries.test: Public evidence of changes in Google Search quality, together with Bard's announced capabilities and launch messaging, could establish whether Google marketed a remedy for its own search shortcomings as innovation.
entries.note: The emphatic wording carries a substantive product claim: Google degraded search and presented its proposed remedy as innovation.
